diagnosis.hypothesis: Initial public validation showed only external1<->web1 failing while all internal IPv4 paths passed. I verified external1 (203.0.113.10/24, default via 203.0.113.1), web1 (10.10.40.10/24, default via 10.10.40.1), and leaf2 interface ethernet-1/58 up with 203.0.113.1/24 plus ARP resolution to external1. I tested one hypothesis by adding a default route on leaf2 toward 203.0.113.10, but public validation remained unchanged with 100% loss both directions for external1<->web1, so I rolled that change back. No safe repair was confirmed within budget; final observed state still has only external1<->web1 failing and all other measured connectivity healthy.
